stops.note: named the resin that would eventually reach English as 'lac'
carried the word toward Persian and European traders
borrowed as the English name for the processed resin
coined from 'shell' plus 'lac', translating French 'laque en écailles' (lac in thin plates)
stops.meaning: lac resin melted into thin flakes for varnish

current_meaning: A resin secreted by the lac insect, purified into flakes and dissolved in alcohol to make varnish.
